name: BrainSAITProviderRegistry
title: BrainSAIT Provider Registry FHIR R4 API
description: Read-only FHIR R4 access to the BrainSAIT Provider Registry: published practitioner profiles, the BPR membership as a PractitionerRole, and the referencing organisations. Licence numbers, uploaded documents, contact details and any other private record are never served.
purpose: Interoperability surface for OpenEMR instances and any EHR or HIS that speaks FHIR R4. Every practitioner resource describes public profile facts only; a credential is present only when it has been verified.
copyright: BrainSAIT. Registry content is published under the registry terms.

rest.documentation: Read-only. There is no write, update, delete, patch, conditional-create or conditional-update interaction, and no subscription channel. Nothing a client sends can change the registry.

security.description: The public read API needs no authentication. It serves published profile facts only and is rate limited.

service.text: Open access for public registry data.

resource.documentation: A healthcare professional published in the registry. Name, specialty, verified qualification kinds and issuers, and the active language. Never a licence number, never a document reference.

searchParam.name: name
searchParam.documentation: Name of the practitioner as published.

searchParam.name: _offset
searchParam.documentation: Zero-based offset into the result set.

operation.name: validate
operation.documentation: Validate a resource against the registry profile.

resource.documentation: The BPR membership of a practitioner, as a role. The period carries the paid membership window when there is one; an expired membership is still returned, with active false.
The registry itself and the authorities a practitioner may be verified against.
